newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy anti-trust closes inquiry on Telecom Italia.
newsitem.headline: Italy anti-trust closes inquiry on Telecom Italia.

text.p: The Italian anti-trust authority said it closed an inquiry into Telecom Italia after the state-controlled telecoms operator took note of aspects of its service that were potentially anti-competitive.

The inquiry about Telecom's Executive Service was opened after a complaint from rival firm Albacom -- a joint venture between British Telecoms, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro and Italian broadcaster Mediaset.
The authority said Telecom Italia's behaviour "could have been fit to constitute violation" of anti-trust regulations.

"Following the observations made by the authority in its inquiry, Telecom took action on aspects which were potentially anti-competition of its Executive system and carried out substantial modifications to its behaviour," the authority said.
